name: Unblock Memory
description: Indexes, retrieves, and analyzes configured workspace memory with existing QMD vectors.

peoplePrimer.enabled.label: People Background Primer
peoplePrimer.enabled.help: Opt in to sending identity, approved excerpts and proposed snippets to TypeSafe. Prepares evidence and checks <=70-word blurbs before replace_dossier saves; disabled/unavailable reviews require explicit manual verification. Existing dossiers are not evidence. Results are accessible to the agent's tool callers.

peoplePrimer.corpora.label: Primer Approved Corpora
peoplePrimer.corpora.help: Explicit non-skill corpus allowlist. Sessions includes all indexed conversations; approve only content suitable for this agent's audiences.

responseAudit.enabled.label: Response Quality Audit
responseAudit.enabled.help: Opt in to background TypeSafe evaluation of approved Slack humans. Operator-only reports; no prompt or memory writes.

responseAudit.sentimentEnabled.label: Human Sentiment Analysis
responseAudit.sentimentEnabled.help: Default on within an enabled, approved response audit. Includes annoyance, frustration and expressed intensity; does not imply agent fault.

responseAudit.intervalMinutes.label: Response Audit Interval (minutes)
responseAudit.intervalMinutes.help: Shared cadence for quality and enabled sentiment analysis. Unchanged successful exchanges are cached. Zero means manual-only.

responseAudit.senderIds.label: Approved Human Sender IDs
responseAudit.senderIds.help: Explicit human Slack user IDs whose exchanges may be sent to TypeSafe. Also requires trusted human identity or owner metadata; explicit bots are always excluded.

responseAudit.memoryCorpora.label: Response Audit Memory Evidence
responseAudit.memoryCorpora.help: Optional configured file corpora approved for current-index memory-gap investigation. Does not prove historical availability.

qualityAudit.enabled.label: Memory Quality Audit
qualityAudit.enabled.help: Enable an on-demand TypeSafe audit. Records review indicators only; never edits or suppresses data.

evidenceReview.enabled.label: Evidence Review
evidenceReview.enabled.help: Opt in to sending proposed claims and explicitly approved indexed evidence to TypeSafe. Advisory only; never writes.

evidenceReview.corpora.label: Evidence Review Corpora
evidenceReview.corpora.help: Explicit non-skill corpus approval for claim evidence sent to TypeSafe.

qualityAudit.corpora.label: Approved Audit Corpora
qualityAudit.corpora.help: Explicit non-skill corpora approved for external TypeSafe processing and maintenance results visible to every audience using this agent. Sessions means ALL indexed sessions, not only the current conversation.

typesafe.enabled.label: TypeSafe Ranking
typesafe.enabled.help: Enabled by default when credentials exist. Sends bounded conversation context and skill descriptions or approved memory excerpts to TypeSafe for enabled whisperers.

typesafe.apiKeyFile.label: TypeSafe Key File
typesafe.apiKeyFile.help: Absolute path to a plaintext API key or a dotenv file containing TYPESAFE_API_KEY. Prefer this over storing a key in config.

keepEmbeddingModelWarm.label: Keep Embedding Model Warm
keepEmbeddingModelWarm.help: Keep the QMD embedding model resident after first use. Disable to unload it after five minutes without model activity.

corpora.label: Memory Corpora
corpora.help: Named groups of exact Markdown files, directories, or globs. Relative paths resolve from each agent workspace. Skill files use the isolated skills corpus. Session corpora can expand matching semantic chunks up to maxExpandedTokens.

skillWhisperer.enabled.label: Skill Whisperer
skillWhisperer.enabled.help: Suggest at most one semantically relevant configured skill before a user turn. Requires hook conversation access.

memoryWhisperer.enabled.label: Memory Whisperer
memoryWhisperer.enabled.help: Inject up to two TypeSafe-approved historical excerpts before user turns. Requires explicit corpora, a TypeSafe key, and hook conversation access. Disabled by default.

memoryWhisperer.corpora.label: Approved Hint Corpora
memoryWhisperer.corpora.help: Explicit non-skill corpus allowlist. Approve file corpora for all audiences using this agent and for transmission to TypeSafe. Session hits are restricted to the exact current session.

people.enabled.label: PeopleSQL
people.enabled.help: Maintain an agent-local people store. Disabled by default.

people.whisperer.enabled.label: People Whisperer
people.whisperer.enabled.help: Inject an enabled person's bounded dossier blurb after exact identity matching. Requires hook conversation access.

analysis.executable.label: Memory Analysis Worker
analysis.executable.help: Optional absolute path to the locally installed unblock-memory-analysis executable.

syncIntervalMinutes.description: Refresh sessions every N minutes while the Gateway runs; 0 disables automatic sync. First refresh is after one interval.

complementaryHints.description: Optionally remove confidently redundant hints with one additional bounded TypeSafe request. Uncertainty retains hints.
